name: Sea fog bank
story: Warm air over the cold sea: a bank of fog lies on the water and the seaplane bases until noon, pulls back offshore in the afternoon and creeps in again at dusk. Inland it is a fine day; at night the moon stands over a sea of fog.
forecast: Fog and low stratus on the coast and the sea until 12:00, the seaplane bases closed; inland strips fine. Fog clearing offshore 12:00-18:00, returning from 20:00. Wind southwest 4-8 kt. Night: fog on the water, clear above.
